pr_title: server: init secondary tenant servers with proper clock parameters
pr_body:
We need to share the code path to initialize the HLC clock between all types of servers.

Fixes #108098.
Epic: CRDB-26687

issue_context.title: server: secondary tenant services don't use the PTP clock device
issue_context.body:
Found by @pavelkalinnikov 

Secondary tenant servers don't use the PTP clock device when configured. They should.

Epic: CRDB-26687

Jira issue: CRDB-30315

review_comments: Since perhaps you'd find it amusing: "a" vs "an" is based on pronunciation rather than spelling, so which to use here is a little up for debate.
